name: The Giant extras
description: The Giant's (BO3 port) teleporter linking (pull a pad's lever, reach the mainframe within 30 seconds; all three open the mainframe door and Pack-a-Punch) and its Easter eggs: the Fly Trap (shoot the panel with a Pack-a-Punched gun, then the three targets, for the Annihilator stand-in) and the spine-jar song. Only active on that map.
